title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 31087290fc26… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 31087290fc269af7921f9591418ac5d0baff3304bc3a18bc7b614546766586e9 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-10-24. This file was detected 9 times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating it was used to stage or deliver a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. There is no information on affected software versions or known exploits in the wild. The file hash serves as an indicator of compromise (IOC) to be matched against files in environments and security tools.
